locators.share_count: Note 19A, PDF pages 236-238; weighted average shares/EPS: Note 43, PDF page 264

currency_basis.rate_type: Indian onshore market closing rate reported by Reuters; not the FBIL reference fixing
currency_basis.method: Constant exchange-rate conversion of USD-denominated monetary inputs at the selected rate. Already-reported INR amounts and the June 30 valuation date are unchanged. Valuation method and group discount assumptions are separately specified in the assumptions file.

status: Provisional acquisition DCF; incomplete financing and opening-balance disclosures
warnings: Provisional model: June 30 valuation using information published through September 11, 2026; not a September spot-price target or point-in-time backtest.
Legacy June cash/CFO/capex and Molycop working capital are estimates; detailed post-close balance sheet not obtained.
Preference fair value and 12% PIK schedule are assumptions; contractual return and exit terms require confirmation.
Molycop FY2026 revenue is inferred from volume and FY2025 realization; it is not reported revenue.
Molycop FY2026 adjusted EBITDA is treated as operating EBITDA; full-year other income and the comparable ten-month earnings pattern are unavailable.
Purchase accounting, intangible lives, tax deductibility, other senior claims and subsidiary minority/JV scope remain provisional.
One group discount rate, terminal growth and ROIC apply to the combined stream. Initial values carry over former legacy assumptions as provisional group choices; they are not calibrated group WACCs.
Ownership-adjusted economic DCF: include 100% legacy and Tega's share of Molycop cash flows and senior claims. These are not statutory consolidated financial statements.

One pooled equity calculation does not value separate subsidiary default options or limited-liability ring-fencing. It may understate downside equity where Molycop shortfalls cannot reach the parent; contractual support remains unresolved.

All USD-origin inputs use INR94.97 per USD at the September 2, 2026 market close. June 30 remains the valuation date; this is a later-date constant-currency restatement. Reported INR actuals are unchanged.
Debt schedules estimate liquidity; they do not certify bank covenants, refinancing availability, preference exit rights or a statutory balanced forecast.
Combined modeled equity is below zero and is floored once at zero; this is not a conclusion about legal debt recourse or an immediate cash shortfall.
Forecast needs additional funding; availability and pricing are not confirmed.

opening_bridge_inr_m.status: Estimated June bridge; not a disclosed June cash/debt breakdown

group_dcf_inr_m.scope: Tega-attributable group cash flows; proportionate enterprise value

scenario_assumptions.rationale: Weaker demand and pricing, slower cost savings, working-capital pressure, higher discount rates; no mine-restart windfall and no earnout payment. Forecast inputs are analyst stress assumptions.
scenario_assumptions.group_valuation_rationale: Discount legacy FCFF plus Tega's ownership share of Molycop FCFF together once. Use proportionate Molycop senior claims and 100% of parent debt. One terminal value and one aggregate equity floor; no separate subsidiary default-option valuation. Group discount/terminal assumptions are provisional.

shared_assumptions.opening_bridge_rationale: June 30 legacy cash is not disclosed separately. Roll March unrestricted liquidity forward using the disclosed contribution and parent loan, Q1 Tega transaction fees, and the above cash-flow estimates. Principal repayments reduce cash and debt equally. Do not add March fundraising cash to post-acquisition equity for free.
shared_assumptions.asset_rationale: Legacy March assets are rolled forward with assumed Q1 commissioning and reported Q1 D&A. Molycop annual D&A starts at June D&A x 12, split between the provisional intangible base / assumed 15-year life and a residual existing-asset charge; that residual is capitalized over 8 assumed remaining years. These are modeling asset balances, not reported PPE. No goodwill amortization or unverified acquisition tax shield.
shared_assumptions.molycop_other_claims_rationale: Provisional reserve of INR4,748.50m converted from the source-currency proxy at the selected rate. Includes unallocated lease/pension/other claims and lower-level minority/JV uncertainty; not a verified fair value or a second deduction of Apollo ordinary equity. Sensitivity uses INR0/4,748.50/9,497.00m. Reconcile net-debt scope before replacement.
shared_assumptions.preference_rationale: INR25,641.90m issue value is a provisional June-end fair-value proxy. Contractual return, redemption premium and exit rights are not quantified in the reviewed filings. The 12% PIK/cash schedule is an analyst stress assumption, NOT a disclosed coupon. Perpetual instrument: no invented mandatory redemption. DCF deducts today's claim once; future PIK is not subtracted again from FCFF.
shared_assumptions.financing_rationale: Interest and repayment schedules are estimates. INR5,983.11m interest plus INR664.79m bank principal translates management's approximate INR6,647.90m ten-month total; the split was not disclosed. Later scheduled bank principal is INR664.79m annually. Lease principal is separately assumed INR284.91m annually. The later 9% cash-interest/net-debt proxy, 70% cash retention and parent sweeps are choices, not contractual rates or covenants. All USD-origin cash amounts use the same September 2 rate.
shared_assumptions.tax_rationale: Normalized marginal cash-tax assumptions; no cross-country loss sharing, acquired tax-loss benefit, or automatic deduction of PPA amortization.
shared_assumptions.pending_issue_rationale: Only a separate pro-forma sensitivity adds the proposed 478435 shares and INR953.99939m cash together. Gross proceeds assumed available; issuance expenses default zero and can be edited. Main issued-share count is unchanged.
shared_assumptions.discount_rate_rationale: One group discount rate, terminal growth and terminal ROIC per scenario. Initial values carry over the previous legacy-Tega assumptions as explicit provisional group choices, not newly calibrated group WACCs. The former separate Molycop discount and terminal assumptions are removed.
